purpose: Offline lookup before retrying a failed CCS/DSS operation. A lookup never connects, halts, resets, builds or loads.

errors.NO_PROBE: Check the selected .ccxml and Windows probe enumeration. Wait for the same probe to be usable before another connection attempt.
errors.CONNECT_FAILED: A normal return from connect is insufficient. Require target.isConnected(true) and a target query; wait before reconnecting.
errors.AMBIGUOUS_CORE: The selected .ccxml exposes zero or multiple matching CPUs. Use a CorePattern that matches exactly one configured core, then verify the reported actual CPU name.
errors.CORE_UNVERIFIED: The retained DSS service did not record an exact CPU name, or the read requested another CPU. Refuse the read; select one core explicitly for a new approved load.
errors.CORE_MISMATCH: DSS opened a CPU different from the one selected from the target configuration. Refuse the load and inspect the .ccxml and core pattern.
errors.-1138: Device refused debug mode. Stop automatic retries; inspect board power, target configuration and the DSS log.
errors.-1041: The emulator lost target access. Stop the load loop, release the DSS session cleanly and verify the probe before retrying.
errors.-150: Probe/driver is not ready. Allow re-enumeration and a usable probe check; do not immediately reconnect.
errors.RESET_FAILED: A reset exception alone is recoverable: if the connection is still valid, attempt halt once and proceed to load. Refuse only if both paths fail.
errors.STOP_UNCLEAN: The DSS stop marker was not written. Treat the session as failed and do not start another load automatically.
errors.PROBE_NOT_READY: DSS exited but the probe has not passed the usable probe check. Wait; do not equate initial PnP appearance with readiness.
errors.STALE_ARTEFACT: The exact selected .out predates a project source, linker input or build configuration. Rebuild and stage that output; also verify linked sources outside the project.
errors.STALE_MAP: The linker map changed after the retained load or cannot be paired with the selected .out. Refuse RAM claims until a fresh matching build is loaded.
errors.RAM_PROOF_UNAVAILABLE: The selected image lacks a pinned map, RAM updater symbol or RAM counter. Integrate the firmware contract and rebuild before a trusted read.
errors.RAM_PROOF_NOT_ADVANCING: The RAM updater counter did not advance. The target may be halted or the required updater was not called; refuse the data.
errors.READ_INCOMPLETE: A read began but did not finish all checks. Do not reuse the previous CSV or success verdict; inspect the child log and retry only after diagnosing the cause.
errors.STALE_SERVICE: The running session's recorded .out SHA256 differs from the selected file. Refuse the read and require an explicitly approved new load.
errors.TARGET_NOT_CONNECTED: A live DSS process is not proof of an accessible target. Refuse the read and diagnose the link.
errors.FW_ID_MISMATCH: The live firmware identity differs from the one recorded at load. Refuse the data; verify the compiled image and selected core.
errors.FW_ID_UNREADABLE: Firmware identity is unavailable. Refuse a trusted read until the image contract supplies it.
errors.HEARTBEAT_FAIL: The application counter is not advancing. Refuse stale readings and diagnose whether the program is halted or stuck.
errors.NOT_RAM_IMAGE: RAM execution has not been established for this session. Refuse debug-stage data rather than interpreting Flash values.
errors.BUF_CHANGED: A supposedly frozen capture changed during transfer. Discard the frame and check the firmware's freeze/sequence protocol.
